plan.onFailure: Stop and report. An unclassified absence, and an absence that already carries a makeup, arrive as errors.

planningRules.rule: Never request a makeup for more than one student. It is against a specific absence, for one student and one subject (BR-1) — a class-wide re-sit is a different thing entirely and this capability cannot express it.
Never classify the absence to make a makeup possible. E1 is the classification rule working, and that decision belongs to whoever knows why the child was away (UC-06-15 BR-5).

Report the existing makeup where one is already there. A second is not created automatically (BR-8), and somebody asking again may not know the first was refused or missed.
Never describe the request as arranging anything. Nothing is scheduled and nobody is told — a makeup nobody was told about produces a second absence (BR-4).

planningRules.rule: Never supply the score. It is a child's result and the teacher's to state, and it is the figure that lifts a result out of incomplete.
Never cap the mark. Whether a makeup mark is capped, and at what, is a school policy decision that is not fixed here (BR-12) — a planner that capped at the pass mark has written the policy.
Never chain a reopening onto locked marks. E6 is BR-11 working: the School Admin reopens the exam deliberately, and the makeup is marked afterwards.
Say plainly that the result will show the mark was earned in a makeup. A mark that reads identically to one sat with the class hides something the school decided (BR-7).

Report whether the result is now complete and whether the student re-enters the merit list. They re-enter once every subject carries a final mark, and not before (BR-10) — a family expecting a position may still not see one.
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A makeup mark is corrected like any other submitted mark — by the Coordinator, with a reason and the previous value kept (UC-06-02 BR-10).

steps.note: One step. The absence is recorded exactly as the first was, and no further makeup is granted automatically (BR-8, A3).

plan.atomicity: One write: the second absence and the audit entry together or not at all. The original classification stands and what it decided still holds — an excused absence still leaves the subject out of the percentage and the result still reads incomplete. The student stays out of the merit list until every subject carries a final mark (BR-10).
